title: contaminated disc is a disqualifier
why: Fluid on the disc is the shop's stated instant-stop condition. This is the money shot: the verdict that holds a machine back from service.

step.title: Inspect the disc face for contamination
step.explanation: Fluid on a disc means the pads are contaminated too. Cleaning the disc and leaving the pads in is the shortcut that puts a bike out with no front brake.

field.acceptance_description: a dry, uncontaminated disc face with no fluid on it
field.guidance: Any wet run on the disc is an instant fail and the job stops.
